g.text: Top vendor's share of all vendor namings, by category
A category's namings are every time any checked vendor was named in a valid answer. Base: 8,085 namings.
Source: Broadcastwell Research, Study 1, from the Absence Index release 2026-09, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22907695. CC BY 4.0.
